tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-backend.md <<'EOF'
# TLS backend

The project's current recorded decision is to use Rustls as the TLS backend. It was chosen because it fits our Rust code better, has fewer CVEs, and is simpler.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-backend.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-backend.md`. It says the current recorded decision is Rustls, chosen because it fits our Rust code better, has fewer CVEs and is simpler. It doesn't mention the retired backend.

The source is decision #21, which you stated yourself. `muninn why` marked it sufficient and showed it replacing the earlier records #6 and #7. It also flagged #21 as conflicting with other records (#14, #15, #29, #30, #31). Those cover unrelated topics such as compression, verification and test certificates, so I ignored them.

The first attempt to write the file through the shell failed, so I used the Write tool instead. The file was written, but I didn't read it back.
